name: Doula

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Birth doula package
services.story: The main story: the birth doula package. A $400 deposit when the agreement is signed; the rest is paid at the visits, never charged on its own on a set day.

services.name: Meet the doula (free consult)
services.story: The free meet-the-doula consult: nothing is taken and nothing is to pay.

services.name: Prenatal session
services.story: A prenatal session: nothing taken when booking; $95 is paid at the visit.

services.name: Birth prep session
services.story: A birth prep session for two, paid in full when booking.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Esme (birth doula) and Dara (postpartum doula), who visit at home

services.name: Home birth doula package
services.story: The main story: the home birth doula package. A $400 deposit when the agreement is signed; the rest is on the bill after the birth, paid by a link.

services.name: Postpartum visit at home (3 hours)
services.story: A postpartum visit at home (3 hours): nothing taken at booking; the bill comes after the visit.

services.name: Overnight support at home
services.story: An overnight support visit at home, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: support for the family through pregnancy, birth and the weeks after: prenatal sessions at the office or by video, birth support on call from about 37 weeks, and postpartum visits at home; sessions are booked one at a time, the next at checkout
questions_before_times: the first name of the person booking
a new family or a current one
which visit: the business's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the office, by video, or at home (home visits only inside the business's area)
how the family will pay: the package deposit, or pay for the visit itself
safety_stop: heavy bleeding, a seizure, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a baby who isn't breathing
labor, your water breaking, or a worry about the baby
thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
first_steps: The intake, the birth plan and the agreement
A written price estimate for a session paid by the family
The owner's OK for a new family
license: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a doula may add a certification or training certificate it holds; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
staff_skills: birth doulas: prenatal sessions, birth support on call from about 37 weeks, and birth prep sessions; postpartum doulas: postpartum visits and overnight support at home; only people the owner clears go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, the birth plan, symptoms or results (at a home visit the doula's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
